report:
DECISION AND EVIDENCE BASE
Completed the bounded check against immutable HEAD acbe192aaac8184b2274a3b53e58139353012454, supplied as plan/verification-evidence/2026-09-22-baseline/rsvp-kernel-preparation/link-down-fix/head-acbe192aaac8184b2274a3b53e58139353012454.tar. Main confirms the archive contains the entire iface component, netlink plugin and core iface events directories, so member absence is meaningful. Recovered all 304 raw lines of artifact://1259, not only its preview. This supersedes my earlier pending-input result.

EXACT CANDIDATE PATH SET
internal/plugins/iface/netlink/monitor_linux.go
internal/plugins/iface/netlink/monitor_linux_test.go
internal/component/iface/monitor_integration_linux_test.go

ALL GO HUNKS
- monitor_linux.go: the seedLinkNames comment is updated to describe first-update carrier emission; handleLinkUpdate removes only the return after EventCreated and adds its rationale. The HEAD state branch, isLinkUp use, existing payloads and constants remain the producer. No counterSource or CounterGeneration dependency is introduced.
- monitor_linux_test.go: TestHandleLinkUpdate_Create now expects created then down and checks the down identity; its Dummy uses the LinkAttrs form already present at HEAD in the adjacent StateChange/Delete tests. StateChange checks initial up plus subsequent up/down; Delete and EmitCreatedPayload adjust positions/counts for the additional initial-state notification. HEAD already has encoding/json, the collecting bus, newTestMonitor and stateEventPayload. No foreign feature hunk is present.
- monitor_integration_linux_test.go: the new preexisting-link test uses HEAD's startTestMonitor, waitForMonitorPayload and monitorTestPayload. HEAD integration_helpers_linux_test.go contains withNetNS, collectingBus, waitForEvent, requireLinkUp and createDummyForTest. The two existing-test hunks wait for creation-time up and clear the collected events before asserting later down/deletion. No new uncommitted helper or producer is required.

DOCUMENTATION HUNK 1: SAFE WITH THIS FIX
The Bus Topics correction (@@ -882,17 +882,23 @@) names committed producers. HEAD internal/core/iface/events/events.go defines created/up/down, addr-added/addr-removed and dhcp-acquired/dhcp-renewed/dhcp-expired. HEAD monitor_linux.go has Unit in link/state payloads, Origin in address payloads, and RTM_DELLINK emits EventDown with linkEventPayload rather than a deleted event. The new paragraph describing state emission on the first RTM_NEWLINK is supplied by the proposed monitor fix. This hunk is not the reason to withhold the document.

DOCUMENTATION HUNK 2: UNSAFE WHOLE-FILE COUPLING
Exact diff hunk: @@ -1014,6 +1020,32 @@. The independent added prose occupies current docs/features/interfaces.md:1023–1047, from “Raw snapshots also carry `counter-generation`” through the driver-reset limitation and counterStatsDecreased source anchor.

Every named repository producer was traced at HEAD:
1. internal/component/iface/iface.go — InterfaceInfo exists, but its complete declaration has NO CounterGeneration field or counter-generation JSON member. The new field anchor and metadata claim are unsupported at HEAD.
2. internal/plugins/iface/netlink/show_linux.go — ListInterfaces and GetInterface exist. HEAD ListInterfaces calls listLinks; HEAD GetInterface calls netlink.LinkByName. Both copy raw link statistics into InterfaceStats; neither supplies continuity metadata or invokes a counterSource snapshot. The function names exist, but the newly claimed producer behavior does not.
3. internal/plugins/iface/netlink/counter_linux.go — ABSENT. Direct archive-member read reports “not found inside archive.” A second lookup listing the complete archived netlink directory independently confirms absence. Therefore counterSource.consume, counterStatsDecreased, counterSource.snapshot and counterSource.invalidate cited by the hunk have no HEAD referent in that file. This directly blocks the single-socket, lifecycle-continuity and notification-history-loss claims.
4. internal/component/iface/counters.go — existing baseline behavior is present as resetCountersViaBackend, setBaseline and clearAllBaselines. The exported ResetCounters entrypoint is in HEAD dispatch.go and delegates to resetCountersViaBackend. Thus the baseline mechanism is committed; the citation names the public entrypoint against the helper file, and it does not provide the missing raw-generation mechanism.
The external Linux statistics link is a limitation reference, not a replacement for the missing repository producer. No broader counter-generation behavior audit was performed.

WHY THE DOCS FILE STAYS OUT
The repository HEAD-dependency rule permits carrying unrelated additive prose only when its named producer is committed. Here both a named source file and its exposed metadata field are absent. Native scoped commits snapshot entire explicit files, as docs/contributing/committing.md:18–22 describes; including interfaces.md would publish both hunks, not just Bus Topics. Consequently the current whole document cannot accompany the three-file monitor commit. This conclusion is about HEAD coupling, not ownership or whether paused work should survive.

PRESERVATION
agent://InheritedFlow.InterfaceEpoch identifies the counter producer work and assigns downstream documentation to InheritedFlow. Nothing was classified as abandoned or unowned. Leave all counter source and the mixed documentation file intact; do not expand this commit into counter-generation implementation, remove prose, or drop source. The precise remaining coupling is the mixed document's counter-generation hunk to its uncommitted producer, not any of the three monitor files.

No formatter, build, lint, test, runtime, edit, or commit was performed. This is source/HEAD scope evidence only; Main owns execution and commit preparation.
